character: weary female agama, sandy-orange hide, backwards cap, thick striped tail, exactly four legs, fills two thirds of frame
props: three fat toads - their place is her back, flanks and tail until 2.2, gripping on with all four hands, never the ground; a tall crooked price post by the trail, only digits; a motorcycle by the trail, leather jacket and aviator goggles on the bar, a big suitcase on the rack holding a beach umbrella, a cheese wheel and an alarm clock
motion_rule: every window she covers ground - charging the lens, galloping across it or riding at it - never standing to speak, never a plain walk; she wrenches, kicks and shakes the toads off, they grab straight back; camera moves with her; new shot size every window
environment: clay trail running at the lens, hard midday sun; background under a third

audio.delivery: weary female voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: TYAzh-ko, do-LOY, BOD-ro-yu, tro-POY, tse-NAKH, ne-BES, SBRO-sit, OT-pusk
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 7.9
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over, mouth visible even on the bike
audio.sfx: pounding claws, croaks, dry pop as the tail tears, engine roar, case latches popping, alarm bell

timeline.a: bursts out of the depth at the lens, dust wall behind
drives at the lens, wrenches the toad off her spine with her whole shoulder
plants both claws and her thick tail tears off at the base with a dry pop, all three toads still on it
freed, she springs to the bike and rips jacket and goggles off the bar | the three thrash on the severed tail
shoulders into the jacket, swings a leg over and stamps the starter, rear wheel spinning a wall of dust over the three
rides straight at the lens down the trail, goggles on, mouth open, the price post rushing past her shoulder
hauls the bars up and the front wheel rears at the sky, engine screaming, dust fanning out
timeline.c: ground level, bike over the lens

timeline.a: rips the suitcase off the rack one-handed and hurls it at the lens
the suitcase bursts in the air, umbrella, cheese wheel and alarm clock tumbling at the lens | she rides on past them
the three toads come stampeding through the dust on the severed tail, hands out at the falling load
the cheese wheel lands on edge, rolls over the three and comes at the lens growing huge
she blasts past the lens wiping the frame, stump twitching, the umbrella cartwheeling behind her

must_appear: tail off with all three toads on it at 1.45-2.2; front wheel reared at 5.25; suitcase hurled at the lens at 6.0; the load bursts out at 6.75; toads stampede through the dust at 7.9
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, letters on the price post, same shot size twice, she stands still while speaking, her mouth hidden, a toad on the ground before 2.2, a gap between her and the toads before 2.2, a window where the toads do nothing, a wide shot with her small in frame, the tail as a plug from a pit, the severed tail gone from frame, the toads sitting still at the end, extra limbs, a fifth leg, deformed anatomy, English speech, any word after 7.9
